title: Multi-time Markov renewal chains and stratified renewal theorems
summary: We develop stratified renewal theorems for multi-time observations of Markov-additive paths on standard Borel state spaces with nonnegative integer vector increments. Horizon directions with the same active constraints form strata. A compact-uniform inverse expansion yields a global limit in a topology combining hypi-convergence with exact restrictions to each stratum. At Brownian scale, the central theorem determines the joint terminal-edge law at fixed finite families of critical horizons about a common direction, under nondegenerate pairwise Gaussian contrasts.
